run_train_sdxl_ip_adapter: run the training script for SDXL IP-Adapter with pretrained model, data JSON, and image encoder paths
create_ip_adapter_module: create an IP-Adapter module with UNet, image projection model, adapter modules, and optional checkpoint path
create_mydataset: create a MyDataset that loads image-text pairs from a JSON file with CLIP image processing and tokenization
build_collate_fn: build a collate_fn that stacks batched tensors for images, text tokens, clip images, and metadata
parse_training_args: parse CLI arguments for pretrained model path, data JSON, image encoder, resolution, learning rate, and batch size
